summary.text: Mike Simpler is the Republican candidate for Delaware House of Representatives District 14 in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which he faces incumbent Claire Snyder-Hall (D).
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a lifelong Coastal Sussex resident, small business owner and healthcare worker.

paragraphs.text: Mike Simpler graduated from Cape Henlopen High School and attended Delaware Technical Community College.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Simpler said he has spent more than 40 years with the Rehoboth Beach Volunteer Fire Company, where he serves as president, works at Beebe Healthcare and owns Rehoboth Hardware.
He said he and his wife, Kim, have five children.
Simpler said his key messages are responsible growth, a lower cost of living and accessible healthcare.
